annotations.title: Meta value rule sets (bid by audience segment)

description: Value rules raise or lower Meta bids for audience segments worth more or less to the advertiser. action list (default) / get / create / replace / delete. rules: [{name, adjustSign INCREASE (1-1000%) or DECREASE (1-90%), adjustValue, criteria: [{criteriaType AGE, GENDER, OS_TYPE, DEVICE_PLATFORM, LOCATION, PLACEMENT, OMNI_CHANNEL or AUDIENCE_LABEL, criteriaValues, criteriaValueTypes (LOCATION only: LOCATION_COUNTRY / REGION / CITY / COMSCORE_MARKET)}]}]; rule order matters, the first match adjusts. Up to 6 sets, 10 rules, 4 criteria. replace sends the WHOLE set (get first; keep ids to keep rules); dropping rules and delete need confirm:true. Attach with update_meta_object on an ad set (value_rule_set_id, value_rules_applied:true). Free.

action.description: list (default), get, create, replace or delete

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared
